static_traits.name: Wen Jie
static_traits.family_status: Parents live across the street,平时会交流,但尚not yet与他们讨论此具体问题
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with a friend becomes strained and alienated due to his frequent criticism of book endings
static_traits.medical_history: without既往相似心理问题;not yet接受过心理治疗;without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,能具体描述阅读体验与细节;倾向关注负面细节并use绝对化评价(如'浪费时间''毁了一切');态度偏消极但配合度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常在读完书后感到失望和挫败,尤其是当书的结尾not符合我的期望时.这种not满从几个月前开始出现并加重,我会not断批评书的结尾,失去了阅读的乐趣.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent disappointment and frustration have affected overall mood and leisure experience, hoping through counseling to reduce negative filtering, restore enjoyment of reading, and improve emotions.

core_beliefs: 如果结尾not符合我的期待,整本书就毫without价值
Leisure activities must be a complete and 'perfect' experience, otherwise it is a waste of time

special_situations.event: 读完一本书后发现结尾仓促或not yet能呼应前期铺垫
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果结尾not符合我提高后的期望,之前所有投入都等于白费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在评价时聚焦负面结尾,negate之前的优点以避免再次失望
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This book made me read in vain; I wasted my time.

special_situations.event: 与朋友讨论书籍时,朋友表示'找更好的书'并难以理解其not满
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not认同我的评价或not理解我的失望,我就会被视为爱抱怨的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Insists on a critical ending to prove one's point, reducing in-depth communication with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not理解我,可能已经厌烦我了.

special_situations.event: Academic pressure增大,阅读作为放松的期待变得更高
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在高压力下,休闲活动必须完全满足期待,否则就not能缓解压力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 为书籍设定更高标准,一旦结尾not佳即negate整本书
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 现在have not哪本书能满足我.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain reliable relaxation and satisfaction through reading, and to keep positive experiences fully preserved
core_conflict.fear: 害怕投入被辜负,时间被浪费,失望Emotional loss of control
defense_goal: 通过严格批评与negate来维持控制感,避免再度被失望伤害

object_relations.self_representation: A misunderstood harsh critic / disappointed reader
object_relations.object_representation: not理解,敷衍建议的他者(朋友)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (such as the counselor or a friend) invite them to recall the positive parts of the book, or offer a balancing view on their judgment that 'the whole book was a waste'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为对方在negate他的感受,忽视他的失望(将自身的被辜负体验Projection到他人'not理解'的意图上)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a calm, organized tone, lists the logical flaws and holes in the ending, downplays or skips subjective feelings; avoids touching the emotional components of positive experiences.

manifestations: Believes the ending 'ruined everything', treats the reading experience as a 'waste of time'
Leisure reading loses its joy, hard to relax
outcomes: Doubting the meaning of leisure activities

manifestations: not yet向住在附近的父母谈及该问题
outcomes: 疏离感增加,Insufficient use of social support

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributes feelings of disappointment and being let down to 'the ending ruined everything', finding it hard to recognize her own raised expectations and pressure factors
认为他人'not理解'自己的not满,从而加剧疏离

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When invited to recall positive parts of the book, quickly turns back to the ending's flaws
Difficult to stay with and deepen positive experiences; instead emphasizes the negative

positive_force: 学业表现not yet受影响,说明自我管理与任务执行能力尚可
Parents live nearby; potential support resources available
Willing to try a balanced perspective and reality testing, with motivation to change
能够识do not并描述书中的优点(独特情节,人物深度)
negative_force: 心理过滤与negate正面思考的模式显著
Under high pressure, forms perfectionistic expectations of leisure activities (all-or-nothing standards)
频繁批评导致Interpersonal tension,支持减弱
Attributes disappointment mainly to the external (the book's ending), ignoring own expectations and situational factors

target_behavior.behavior: 在读完书后过度聚焦并批评结尾,negate整本书并出现显著的失望与挫败情绪
antecedent: 完成阅读并遭遇结尾not合Anticipation或仓促
近期Academic pressure较大,期待提高
与朋友讨论书籍时遭遇not被理解或被建议'找更好的书'
target_behavior.core_reason: 在Academic pressure下形成完美化与非黑即白的评价标准,伴随心理过滤与negate正面思考,将结尾的not满等同于整体失败与时间浪费
target_behavior.function: Avoids feelings of disappointment and being let down, maintaining a sense of control over and high expectations of leisure experiences
target_behavior.consequence: 整体Low mood,休闲体验与放松能力下降;Tense relationships with friends;阅读乐趣减少
